{{Top}}
{{Quote|Aaaaaaaaahhh! What are you doing?! Remove the arc wrench, remove the arc wrench! Medic!|[[HK-47]] to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], after Revan failed to access his memory core|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''power wrench''' was a tool presumably similar in use to a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]].
In [[3956 BBY]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] used a presumably similar tool called an arc wrench to try to access [[HK-47]]'s memory core.
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] kept a power wrench in the garage of the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and used it for repair work on his [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]].
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used power wrench for taking out old [[sensor array window]] when working on [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
